{{Top|leg}}
'''Clusterfrag launchers''' were anti-personnel turrets developed by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and mounted on [[armored lander]]s used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[New Republic Marine]]s used the turrets during the [[Battle of Mindor]] against the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
